title: Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer
alloyReason: Pt-coated Grade 1 CP-Ti (UNS R50250) is engineered for Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer in electrochemical applications where platinum cladding (2.5 µm minimum) provides catalytic surface activity while the ultra-ductile Grade 1 substrate (24% elongation) withstands thermal cycling without delamination. The Pt/Ti interface forms a diffusion bond at >50 MPa peel strength, ensuring long-term service in PEM electrolyzer liquid-gas diffusion layer (sintered). This rationale is driven by pem electrolyzer liquid-gas diffusion layer (sintered) and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding all positions with 0.5mm corner radius
DPI dye penetrant inspect with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for pem electrolyzer liquidgas application
inspection: UT volumetric full matrix (pem electrolyzer verified)
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for pem electrolyzer liquidgas performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer have?
faq.a: Grade 1 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer is suitable for pem electrolyzer liquidgas in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer?
faq.a: Each Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for pem electrolyzer liquidgas.
